ABS Non-Conformity : Requirement:
The Company should identify potential emergency shipboard situations, and establish procedures to respond to them.
SMS Procedure PR-0803 "Guidance for shipboard emergency response actions - Fire incident" states: 
"The following action  to be taken as soon as the extent of the damage is identified:

- 
Ensure personal safety onboard 

The damage control team should continue to extinguish the fire, shut off ventilation, and close all accessible opening and hatches to prevent fire spreading".
Evidence:
The Fire in the Garbage Store Drill observed during the audit was executed sufficiently to control and extinguish the fire. However, the following steps were omitted:

- 
Boundary cooling took place only on the Garbage store door and not the boundary bulkhead.

- 
The vent was not shut off.

- 
The light inside the space and its electrical source were not shut off.

- 
A crewmember was observed wearing regular shoes instead of safety shoes.

The Drill was repeated with the Captain's concurrence to positive results and with all above actions taken.
Nature:
Several steps towards fighting the fire were not observed during the Fire Drill.

ABS Non-Conformity : Requirements:
The Company should establish procedures, plans and instructions, , including checklist as appropriate, for key shipboard operations concerning the safety of the personnel, ship and protection of the environment. The various tasks should be defined and assigned to qualified personnel.
a) "Enclosed Space Work Permit" form CK-0750-2 states:
"The atmospheric test frequency is established with a reference value of 15 minutes. The competent person may adjust this frequency based on on-scene considerations and conditions; however, it must not exceed 15 minutes in any case.
b) "High Voltage Electrical Work Permit" form CK-0706-7 states:
"A Risk Assessment has been carried out for the proposed work".
c) Procedure PR-0707 "Voyage Planning states:
"The detailed voyage plan or passage plan should include the following factors: [...] The method and frequency of position fixing".
Voyage Plan form "Route Plan" for the vessel's voyage to Long Beach specifies position fixing intervals of 10-15 minutes during coastal navigation and 1 hour at open sea. 
Evidence:
a) 

- 
Enclosed Space Work Permit dated 19 May 2025 for Fresh Water Tank Cleaning indicates that crew were inside the space from 08:37 until 10:50. Only three (3) atmospheric tests were recorded, at 09:10, 09:25 and 09:40.

- 
Enclosed Space Work Permit dated 26 June 2025 for Fresh Water Tank Cleaning indicates that crew were inside the space from 08:23 until 11:00. Only three (3) atmospheric tests were recorded, at 08:22, 08:37 and 08:52.

- 
Enclosed Space Work Permit dated 08 February 2025 for Scrubber Body Inspection indicates that crew were inside the space from 10:00-11:20. Only three (3) atmospheric tests were recorded, at 10:15, 10:30 and 10:50.

- 
Enclosed Space Work Permit dated 07 February 2025 for Scavenge Air Receiver work indicates that crew were inside the space from 13:36-16:15. Only three (3) atmospheric tests were recorded, at 13:30, 14:30 and 15:30.

The crew were found unaware that the 15-minute atmospheric tests are required to continue throughout the whole duration of Enclosed Space Entry.
b) No evidence could be provided that Risk Assessments were reviewed in conjunction with the "High Voltage Electrical Work Permit" for the following instances:

- 
Alternative Marine Power (AMP) connection on 03 October 2024 and 06 August 2025

- 
AMP insulation and function check on 05 September 2024, 23 July 2025 and 19 August 2025.

c) The following instances indicated that required position fixing intervals were not being adhered to:

- 
On 18 August, while the vessel was at open sea, no position fixing was conducted between 15:00-20:00.

- 
On 20 August 2025, while the vessel was at open sea, no position fixing was conducted between 03:00-08:00 and 15:00-20:00.

- 
On 23 August 2025, while the vessel was approaching Long Beach, position fixes took place at 20 minute intervals between approximately 03:00 and 07:00.

Nature:
a) Repetitive atmosphere checks were not being conducted as required.
b) Risk Assessments were not being conducted for AMP work.
c) Position fixing intervals specified in the voyage plan were not followed.
Note: 
The root cause shall be provided for 
each item listed
 and individual corrective and preventive action shall be taken as necessary.

ABS Non-Conformity : Nature:
The Company should establish procedures for the implementation of corrective action, including measures intended to prevent recurrence.
Procedure PR-0902 "Near Miss" states: "The Safety Department is responsible for acknowledging and verifying near-misses or minor incidents reported by the Master. If needed, it will perform thorough investigations based on facts and provide recommendations for corrective action to eliminate the potential for any future hazard."
Preventive Actions for Near Miss Report dated 14 March 2024 (CO2 Cylinder leak) include:

- 
"Carry out Risk Assessment when entering".

The Preventive Action was verified and closed out by the company on 18 April 2024. 
Evidence:
The Risk Assessment was not utilized for CO2 room entries on the following dates:

- 
27 July 2025

- 
28 March 2025

- 
28 February 2025

- 
29 January 2025

- 
29 December 2024

- 
29 November 2024

Therefore, the Corrective Action Plan for the Near Miss dated 14 March 2024 was not implemented effectively.
Nature:
The Corrective Action Plan for a Near Miss was not effectively implemented.

ABS Non-Conformity : Requirements:
The safety-management system should ensure:

- 
compliance with mandatory rules and regulations; and

- 
that applicable codes, guidelines and standards recommended by the Organization, Administrations, classification societies and maritime industry organizations are taken into account.

Resolution MEPC.277(70) states "The entry for each completed incineration shall include date and time and position of the ship (latitude and longitude) at the start and stop of incineration, categories of garbage incinerated and the estimated amount incinerated for each category in cubic meters".
SMS Procedure 03-05-00 "Garbage Management" states: 
"Entries in the Garbage Record book shall be made on each of the following occasions:

- 
Garbage is incinerated - include estimated amount incinerated in cubic meters"

Oil Record Book's "List of items to be Recorded" includes "time and place of replacing 15 ppm equipment parts".
Evidence:

- 
Incineration of sea chest strainer waste took place on 18 February 2025 and 31 January 2025 as indicated in the Anti-fouling Record Book. However, the quantity of incinerated waste was not indicated in the relevant Garbage Record Book entries.

- 
The 15 ppm Oil Content Meter of the Oily Water Separator was replaced on 21 July 2024 as indicated in a job report of the same date. No relevant entry was made in the Oil Record Book to indicate the time and place of replacement.

Nature:
Oil Record Book and Garbage Record Book entries were not as required.
